templates.description: Base layout template extended by all pages. Contains sidebar navigation linking to all 10 routes (/ideas, /generate, /articles, /images, /publish, /pinterest, /verify, /adcash, /settings). Includes a global JavaScript runScript() function that POSTs to /api/run_script with {script_name, args} and streams output into a terminal div.

Main dashboard page showing stats overview and workflow visualization. Displays 4 stat cards (Local Articles, Published, Pending Ideas, Estimated Revenue), a 5-step workflow diagram (Ideas→Generate→Verify→Publish→Monitor), and a terminal-style recent activity log.
static_data: All stat values hardcoded (10, 0, 0, $0). Activity log is hardcoded sample text.
templates.stub_reason: All dashboard data is hardcoded — no dynamic fetching from backend. Stats do not reflect actual state.

templates.description: Ideas management page with a table of ideas (Title, Keyword, CPM, Status, Actions) and an 'Add Idea' form at the bottom. Each row has a 'Gerar' button and a delete button.
forms: Add Idea form with title input field
buttons: 'Gerar Ideias IA' (top button - NO handler), 'Gerar' per-row (calls runScript('gerar_artigos.py', ['--topic', keyword])), Delete '×' per-row (NO handler)
missing_functionality: 'Gerar Ideias IA' button has no onclick handler
Delete button has no onclick handler
Add Idea form has no submit button or form action — input field collects nothing
Table data is passed via Jinja2 {{ ideas }} but no delete/submission endpoint is wired
templates.stub_reason: Only the per-row 'Gerar' button works. AI idea generation button, delete, and add-idea form are non-functional.

templates.description: Article generation page with a form for keyword, article size (Long/Medium/Short), and tone of voice (Professional/Casual/Technical). Has a terminal log area for generation output.
forms: Keyword input, Size select, Tone select
missing_functionality: Size and tone selects are NOT passed to the script — only keyword is sent as an argument
The selects have no id/name attributes for programmatic access
templates.stub_reason: Partially functional — keyword generation works but size/tone parameters are ignored.

templates.description: Lists generated articles with filename, size, and date. Each article has 4 action buttons: Generate Image, Verify, Publish, Pinterest.
buttons: Refresh (no handler), Gerar Imagem (no handler), Verificar (no handler), Publicar (no handler), Pinterest (no handler)
missing_functionality: ALL 4 action buttons have no onclick handlers
Refresh button has no onclick handler
No navigation to image/verify/publish pages from these buttons
templates.stub_reason: All buttons are purely visual — none trigger any action. This is a display-only shell.

templates.description: Image gallery showing generated article images. Displays one hardcoded image card (nvme-ssd-vs-sata.png) and a 'Gerar Nova Imagem' placeholder card.
buttons: Upload Manual (no handler), Download (no handler), Delete (no handler), Gerar Nova Imagem card (no handler)
static_data: Single hardcoded image entry with filename and timestamp
templates.stub_reason: Entirely static — hardcoded image data, no dynamic loading, all buttons non-functional.

templates.description: WordPress publishing queue table showing articles with scheduled date, category, status, and action buttons.
buttons: Enviar/WordPress button (no handler), Editar button (no handler)
static_data: 2 hardcoded articles with hardcoded statuses (Pronto, Agendado)
templates.stub_reason: 100% hardcoded — no dynamic data from backend, no publish/edit handlers wired.

templates.description: Pinterest marketing page showing scheduled pins, impressions stats, and a list of pending pins.
static_data: Hardcoded stats (5 Pins Scheduled, 1.2k Impressions), hardcoded pin entry
templates.stub_reason: 100% hardcoded — no dynamic data, no API integration, cancel button non-functional.

templates.description: SEO & quality verification page with an article selector dropdown and a terminal showing a sample SEO report.
static_data: Hardcoded article options in select, hardcoded SEO report output in terminal
templates.stub_reason: Entirely static — hardcoded article list, hardcoded report output, no verification trigger.

templates.description: AdCash revenue reporting page showing balance and eCPM stats, with a placeholder chart area.
dynamic_data: Uses Jinja2 template variables: stats.total_revenue, stats.avg_ecpm, stats.last_updated, stats.currency
static_data: Chart area is a placeholder with text 'integração completa será exibida aqui'
templates.stub_reason: Stats cards are dynamically rendered (only template that uses real data), but chart is a placeholder and no filtering/period controls exist.

templates.description: Settings page with two cards: AI configuration (API key input, model select) and WordPress integration (site URL, application password).
forms: AI settings form (API key, model select), WordPress settings form (site URL, application password)
buttons: 'Salvar IA' button (no handler), 'Testar Conexão' button (no handler)
missing_functionality: Neither form has a submit action or form action attribute
Salvar IA button has no onclick handler
Testar Conexão button has no onclick handler
Input values are hardcoded placeholders — no reading of actual saved config
templates.stub_reason: Forms are purely visual — no save/test functionality wired.

critical_findings: layout.html runScript() function works and POSTs to /api/run_script — this is the only functional API call mechanism
generate.html is the ONLY page where runScript() is effectively wired (keyword generation works)
ideas.html per-row 'Gerar' button also calls runScript() successfully
All other buttons across all templates are non-functional decoration
Only adcash.html receives any dynamic data from the backend (Jinja2 stats variable)
No forms have submit handlers — settings, verify, ideas add-form are all visual shells
The UI redesign replaced functional templates with CSS mockups that lack interactivity
